entries.meaningZh: 调解的（据完整mediation父条和直接词典另补形容词义）
entries.en: Her mediational role required her to keep both families talking after the meeting broke down.
entries.zh: 她承担调解职责，会议破裂后仍须让两家人继续对话。

entries.meaningZh: 荡妇（旧式侮辱性称呼，并非中性描述）
entries.en: She walked out when her host called her a floozy in front of the other guests.
entries.zh: 主人当着其他客人的面骂她是“荡妇”，她便走了出去。

entries.meaningZh: 做（do的古式第二人称单数现在时，与thou连用；此例为实义动词）
entries.en: 'Thou dost thy work with care,' the old master tells his apprentice in the tale.
entries.zh: “汝做事用心，”故事中的老师傅对学徒说道。

entries.meaningZh: 人格主义的（此例另选哲学义，不是笼统的“人格的”）
entries.en: Her personalistic argument begins with the dignity and uniqueness of each individual.
entries.zh: 她的人格主义论证以每个个体的尊严和独特性为出发点。

entries.meaningZh: Coalite无烟燃料（一种产品名）
entries.en: He fetched a bucket of Coalite from the shed and set it beside the unlit stove.
entries.zh: 他从棚屋里提来一桶Coalite无烟燃料，放在尚未点燃的炉子旁。

entries.meaningZh: 占优势地（此例指某种颜色占主要部分）
entries.en: The mural was dominantly blue, broken only by a few yellow squares.
entries.zh: 壁画以蓝色为主，只点缀着几块黄色方块。

entries.meaningZh: 塔珀家用塑料制品（此例为该品牌的食物容器）
entries.en: She put the leftover rice in Tupperware and cleared the table.
entries.zh: 她把剩米饭装进塔珀牌家用塑料容器里，然后收拾餐桌。

entries.meaningZh: 鬃丘（此例明确为脊顶尖锐、两侧陡斜的山脊）
entries.en: The path followed the narrow crest of the hogback before descending to the stream.
entries.zh: 小路沿着那道鬃丘狭窄的脊顶延伸，然后下行到溪边。

entries.meaningZh: 豪迈冒险者（另选勇敢、爱冒险人物义，不是泛指欺凌者）
entries.en: The film's swashbuckler swings across the courtyard to rescue the trapped messenger.
entries.zh: 电影里的那位豪迈冒险者荡过庭院，救出被困的信使。

entries.meaningZh: （肉切丝后）加蘑菇和酸奶油炒的（此例作后置形容词）
entries.en: She served beef stroganoff made with thin strips of meat sautéed with mushrooms and sour cream.
entries.zh: 她端上了用细牛肉条加蘑菇和酸奶油炒制的菜肴。

entries.meaningZh: 漂亮的；整洁的（此例为较少见的形容词用法）
entries.en: She arrived in a trig blue jacket with every brass button polished.
entries.zh: 她穿着一件整洁漂亮的蓝夹克来到，黄铜纽扣颗颗锃亮。

entries.meaningZh: 迷糊健忘的（英式非正式；此例另选心不在焉义）
entries.en: She was so scatty that morning that she put the cereal in the fridge and the milk in the cupboard.
entries.zh: 那天早上她迷糊得把麦片放进冰箱，却把牛奶放进橱柜。

entries.meaningZh: 种荚；含种子的荚状果实（此例不是原条“心皮”）
entries.en: A dry seedpod split open in her hand and scattered its seeds across the table.
entries.zh: 一个干燥的种荚在她手里裂开，种子散落到桌上。

entries.meaningZh: 比博普爵士乐乐手（此例不泛指所有早期爵士乐音乐家）
entries.en: The bopper set down his saxophone and listened to the pianist's solo.
entries.zh: 那位比博普爵士乐乐手放下萨克斯，听钢琴手独奏。

entries.meaningZh: 按人头定额付费的（另选医疗付费义，不是原条头状、腕骨义）
entries.en: The fictional clinic operates under a capitated contract, receiving a fixed sum per patient rather than a fee for each visit.
entries.zh: 这家虚构的诊所在按人头定额付费合同下运作，每位患者对应一笔固定款项，而不是每次就诊分别收费。

entries.meaningZh: 索格拉斯球场
entries.en: At Sawgrass, she stayed on the practice green until the last light faded.
entries.zh: 在索格拉斯球场，她一直留在练习果岭上，直到最后一丝天光消失。

entries.meaningZh: 惠特菲尔德（美国地名）
entries.en: The letter from Wheatfield arrived with a small photograph of their old house.
entries.zh: 从惠特菲尔德寄来的信附着一张他们旧居的小照片。

entries.meaningZh: 已重拍；被重拍（retake的过去分词，此例明确为照片重摄）
entries.en: The photograph had to be retaken because a thumb had covered the lens.
entries.zh: 那张照片不得不重拍，因为一根拇指挡住了镜头。

entries.meaningZh: 重新认证（此例指再次认证过程，不仅是换发证件）
entries.en: Her recertification involved a practical assessment as well as a written test.
entries.zh: 她的重新认证包括实际操作考核和笔试。

entries.meaningZh: 尺蠖；拱背爬行的毛虫（此例另选昆虫义，不是套口机或打环者）
entries.en: The looper arched its body and inched along the edge of the leaf.
entries.zh: 那条尺蠖拱起身体，沿着叶缘一点点向前爬。

entries.meaningZh: 泼妇（贬称，常针对女性，并非中性描述）
entries.en: In the play, he calls his neighbour a hellcat after she refuses to lend him money.
entries.zh: 剧中，邻居拒绝借钱给他后，他便骂她是“泼妇”。

entries.meaningZh: 圆颅党人（英国内战时期议会派称呼）
entries.en: The historical novel follows a young Roundhead carrying dispatches through the rain.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说描写一位年轻的圆颅党人在雨中递送公文的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 空谈（非正式，blah的第三人称单数动词形式）
entries.en: He blahs about his grand plans while everyone else does the work.
entries.zh: 别人都在干活，他却只空谈自己的宏伟计划。

entries.meaningZh: 香馥（此例为香料的浓郁香气，不是辣味）
entries.en: The spiciness of the cloves filled the kitchen long before the cake was baked.
entries.zh: 离蛋糕烤好还有好一会儿，丁香的香气就已弥漫了厨房。

entries.meaningZh: 杜比系统（此例为磁带降噪系统）
entries.en: He switched on Dolby to reduce the tape hiss before playing the recording.
entries.zh: 播放录音前，他打开杜比降噪系统，减少磁带的嘶嘶声。

entries.meaningZh: 头像照（指肖像照片成品，此例不是拍摄动作）
entries.en: She clipped a recent headshot to the audition form.
entries.zh: 她把一张最近拍的头像照夹在试镜申请表上。

entries.meaningZh: 傻瓜（贬称，此例用于自嘲）
entries.en: 'What a dimwit I was to leave the key inside,' he said, staring at the locked door.
entries.zh: “我把钥匙留在里面，真是个傻瓜，”他望着锁上的门说道。

entries.meaningZh: 重粘土（主要为英式用语）
entries.en: The gault clung to his boots as he crossed the freshly dug ground.
entries.zh: 他走过刚挖过的地面时，重黏土粘在他的靴子上。

entries.meaningZh: 船用的
entries.en: The replacement was a shipboard pump designed for use at sea.
entries.zh: 替换件是一台专为海上使用而设计的船用泵。

entries.meaningZh: 列举；逐项计数（较少见的动词用法）
entries.en: The clerk began to numerate the parcels as they were lifted onto the cart.
entries.zh: 包裹被搬上推车时，职员开始逐件计数。

entries.meaningZh: 诡辩者（贬称）
entries.en: The playwright makes the sophist win every argument by quietly changing the question.
entries.zh: 剧作家让那位诡辩者靠悄悄偷换问题赢得每一次争论。

entries.meaningZh: 罗穆卢斯（罗马神话人物）
entries.en: The children argued over who would play Romulus in the school production.
entries.zh: 孩子们争论着谁来在学校的演出中扮演罗穆卢斯。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔伯克基（美国地名）
entries.en: Our suitcase was still in Albuquerque when we reached the next hotel.
entries.zh: 我们到下一家酒店时，手提箱还在阿尔伯克基。

entries.meaningZh: 女权纳粹（极具侮辱性的称呼，并非中性女权主义者称谓）
entries.en: She objected when a radio caller dismissed her equal-pay proposal by calling her a feminazi.
entries.zh: 一位广播节目来电者称她为“女权纳粹”，以此贬低她的同工同酬提议，她对此表示抗议。

entries.meaningZh: 雏量级拳击手（特定体重级别，不宣称是所有级别中最轻者）
entries.en: The bantamweight stepped onto the scales and waited for the official's nod.
entries.zh: 那位雏量级拳击手站上体重秤，等待工作人员点头。

entries.meaningZh: 威尔士（威尔士语名称，此例作地名）
entries.en: They crossed into Cymru as the last daylight faded behind them.
entries.zh: 最后的天光在他们身后渐暗时，他们进入了威尔士。

entries.meaningZh: 斯巴鲁汽车
entries.en: The family's old Subaru coughed twice before the engine started.
entries.zh: 这家人的旧斯巴鲁汽车吭哧了两声，发动机才启动。

entries.meaningZh: 决不（旧式、诗歌中的never缩约）
entries.en: In the ballad, she swears she will ne'er abandon the child.
entries.zh: 歌谣中，她发誓决不抛下那个孩子。

entries.meaningZh: 沉思地（据完整contemplative父条和直接词典另补副词义）
entries.en: He turned the empty cup contemplatively between his hands before answering.
entries.zh: 回答之前，他若有所思地在双手间转动着那只空杯。

entries.meaningZh: 理解迟钝（另选理解事理迟缓的状态，不是感觉麻木）
entries.en: Her apparent obtuseness was an act; she understood the joke perfectly well.
entries.zh: 她显得迟钝只是装出来的；她完全听懂了那个笑话。

entries.meaningZh: 帆船水手
entries.en: The old windjammer mended a torn sail while the ship lay at anchor.
entries.zh: 船抛锚停泊时，那位老帆船水手缝补了一面破帆。

entries.meaningZh: 印度馕饼（另补发酵扁面包义，不是原条“奶奶”）
entries.en: She tore the warm naan into pieces and passed a piece to each guest.
entries.zh: 她把温热的印度馕饼撕成小块，分给每位客人一块。

entries.meaningZh: 八倍地（此例为增至原来的八倍）
entries.en: Output increased eightfold after the new kiln opened.
entries.zh: 新窑投入使用后，产量增加到了原来的八倍。

entries.meaningZh: 的确；真实地（旧式文学用语）
entries.en: 'Verily, this is a hard road,' says the traveller in the tale.
entries.zh: “这的确是一条艰难的道路，”故事里的旅行者说道。
